The firing schedule for the coming year

Two firings a year, in March and October, and everything that has to happen before either of them.

Loading takes three days and the firing itself runs for four, with two people stoking in six-hour shifts through the night.

The kiln is then left sealed for a full week to cool, because opening it early cracks the glaze on everything inside.

Greenware has to arrive a month beforehand, since the bisque firing must be finished before loading can begin.
